rules.why: stage 1 (alarm rules): picked on > 0.25, at least 6 frames, smoothing 5, join gaps of 2, score = mean on ctx0_noise1_rand200_neg1_hard0; 0.297 false alarms/h at 80% recall (FruitPunch's rule: 0.498 false alarms/h at 80% recall)

2a.why: stage 2a (noise clips used): picked ctx0_noise1_rand200_neg1_hard0 (0.64 s window, noise x1, 200 random frames/day, 1:1 negatives, 0 hard-negative rounds)

2b.why: stage 2b (random forest frames per day): picked ctx0_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard0 (0.64 s window, noise x1, 1000 random frames/day, 1:1 negatives, 0 hard-negative rounds)

2c.why: stage 2c (negatives per rumble): picked ctx0_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard0 (0.64 s window, noise x1, 1000 random frames/day, 1:1 negatives, 0 hard-negative rounds)

3.why: stage 3 (listening window): picked ctx1_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard0 (1.92 s window, noise x1, 1000 random frames/day, 1:1 negatives, 0 hard-negative rounds); ctx6_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard0 scored lower but within the run-to-run spread, so the simpler one is kept

combos.why: stage 4 (combinations): picked ctx1_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard0 (1.92 s window, noise x1, 1000 random frames/day, 1:1 negatives, 0 hard-negative rounds); ctx6_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard0 scored lower but within the run-to-run spread, so the simpler one is kept

mistakes.why: stage 5 (hard negatives): picked ctx1_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard0 (1.92 s window, noise x1, 1000 random frames/day, 1:1 negatives, 0 hard-negative rounds); ctx1_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard3 scored lower but within the run-to-run spread, so the simpler one is kept

rules_final.why: stage 6 (alarm rules for the final model): picked on > 0.2, at least 8 frames, smoothing 5, join gaps of 2, score = mean on ctx1_noise1_rand1000_neg1_hard0; 0.191 false alarms/h at 80% recall (FruitPunch's rule: 0.245 false alarms/h at 80% recall)
